impactRouting.description: Any change to the studio constitution

rules.reason: Constitution invariants may need new or updated mustContainAll entries
Authority classification or routing rules may need adjustment
Agent behavior semantics may be affected by new governance rules
Claude agents mirror Copilot agents and must reflect updated semantics
Templates may need new sections or updated guidance
Must reflect current governance state and workflow sequence
Structure doc may need updates if paths or conventions changed
Must reflect constitution rules in quickstart form
Must reflect updated methodology rules

Claude Code adapter may need updated governance bootstrap metadata
Copilot context may need updated governance references

impactRouting.description: Any change to the shared runtime contract

rules.reason: Hook consumes contract for sharedGatePaths and audit invocation
Audit script validates contract invariants
Contract changes may reflect constitution-level decisions

impactRouting.description: Any change to Copilot runtime agent definitions

rules.reason: Agent invariants may need updated mustContainAll entries
Claude mirrors must stay in sync with Copilot source

impactRouting.description: Any change to SDD document templates

rules.reason: Template invariants may need updated mustContainAll entries
Agents may reference template structure or field names
Template changes may warrant constitution-level documentation

impactRouting.description: Any change to git hook validation logic

rules.reason: Hook invariants may need updated entries
Hook behavior changes may need governance documentation
Quickstart may reference hook behavior

rules.reason: Script invariants may need updated entries

impactRouting.description: Any change to feature spec that affects requirements referenced in downstream artifacts

rules.reason: Readiness classification may change if requirements changed
Scope compression tracking may need new or updated rows
